run_language_id_inference: run language identification inference on audio files using a fairseq model and manifest
run_subset_manifest: run subset_manifest to filter an inference manifest based on verification pairs
run_wrap_target_dataset: run wrap_target_dataset to add language labels from a .lang file to an audio dataset
run_resample_sample: run resample_sample to create multiple random crops of audio samples for inference
run_dict_to_nparr: run dict_to_nparr to convert a fairseq dictionary symbols list into numpy arrays
